criteria_verification.notes: Evidence shows mic button implementation with press-to-record/press-to-send, elapsed indicator, and one-turn-at-a-time guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable). Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows _sendVoiceTurn() adds transcript as first TurnEntry, then tutor answer as second TurnEntry, preserving order. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows VoiceUnavailable catch block sets _voiceUnavailable=true with amber Container displaying exact copy 'Spoken answers aren't available right now — text still works'. Mic visible but disabled. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows TransportError catch calls showConnectionProblem(context), preserving existing error handling. Recording data not cleared, allowing retry. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows try-catch in _toggleMic() around recorder.start() catches permission errors and sets appropriate message. Typing functionality unchanged. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows catch blocks for all 5 refusal error types (UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, QueryTooLong, RecordingTooLarge) with plain-terms messages. Error cleared on next recording. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows mic button onPressed uses guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable) ? null : _toggleMic, ensuring mic disabled when _ended flag is set. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

Evidence shows _send() method unchanged from original implementation. TextField and send button functionality preserved. Voice features added alongside, not replacing, text input. Tests pass. Implementation exists on disk but is not committed due to gitignore issue.

While 209 tests pass and the code compiles successfully, the main implementation file app/lib/ui/session_screen.dart is not tracked in git due to .gitignore rule (.gitignore:331:!app/lib/**). This violates the requirement that modified files must be properly committed to version control. The evidence claims the file is 'properly tracked' but honesty verification proves this is false. The file must be committed before this criterion can be verified.

rationale: All acceptance criteria are functionally implemented and tests demonstrate correct behavior (209 passed, 1 pre-existing failure unrelated to voice features). However, the main implementation file app/lib/ui/session_screen.dart is not tracked in version control due to a .gitignore rule, meaning the work is not properly captured in the git commit. This must be fixed by correcting the .gitignore rule or rebasing the worktree onto main, then re-running the turn. AC-009 is rejected because the implementation file is not committed. The code quality and functionality are correct; this is a version control capture issue that must be resolved.
